title: Room Reservations: Reversing the Excess of a Late Cancellation Penalty
content:
## Finance desk note

A late cancellation penalty that was kept at more than the penalty a late cancellation owes is reversed for the excess, under the reason that the plan's penalty basis was misapplied, naming the original penalty it reverses. A reversal is posted only on a reservation whose status is cancelled, against a late cancellation penalty recorded on that same reservation, and each penalty is reversed at most once. When the penalty was kept from money held, the reversed amount is returned to the card on file. The note concerns late cancellation penalties on Room Reservations reservations.

| Element | Position |
|---|---|
| Reservation | status cancelled, as the reservation record shows |
| Penalty reversed | a late cancellation penalty recorded on that same reservation, named by the reversal |
| Recorded reason | the plan's penalty basis was misapplied |
| Amount | the excess of the penalty kept over the penalty the late cancellation owes |
| How often | each penalty reversed at most once |
| Where the money goes | back to the card on file, including where the penalty was kept from money held |

The guest sees the reversal in the reservation's charge history straight away.

## Recording the reversal: `reverse_penalty_excess_975f0de4`

**Capability.** The tool reverses part of a late cancellation penalty on one room reservation because the plan's penalty basis was misapplied. One new reversal entry is recorded on the reservation for the amount given, dated today, naming the original penalty entry and recorded where that penalty was settled; the amount reversed goes back to the card on file.

**Invocation.** It is an agent-side tool: guest services unlocks `reverse_penalty_excess_975f0de4` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `reservation_id` — reference number of the cancelled room reservation the penalty sits on, as returned by the reservation lookup (identifier).
- `related_charge_id` — reference number of the original late cancellation penalty entry being reversed, as returned by the reservation charge lookup for that reservation (identifier).
- `amount` — amount of the penalty reversed, in USD, positive, with 2 decimal places, written as a plain number such as 123.45; stored exactly as given, rounded to 2 decimal places.

**Return.** A text receipt of a dictionary with the keys `charge_id` (reference of the new reversal entry), `reservation_id` (the reservation credited), `related_charge_id` (the penalty entry reversed), `amount` (the amount reversed, USD with 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (the date of the reversal, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`, the literal "reversed", which shows the reversal was recorded.

## Points of judgement

- **A penalty already reversed once.** It is not reversed again.
- **A no-show charge.** This note covers late cancellation penalties recorded on cancelled reservations.
- **A penalty kept at exactly what the cancellation owes.** There is no excess, so there is nothing to reverse.
